title: US-90 Corridor Master Plan — Multi-Use Trail
description: The Bluffline directly advances this plan's implementation framework. Along Scenic Highway, the CMP identifies strong public support for a multi-use trail serving Bay Bluffs Park with direct connectivity into downtown, recommending continued feasibility advancement and Land Trail Priority designation. The Bluffline Scenic Bluffs segment operationalizes these recommendations through a protected waterfront corridor that resolves right-of-way and erosion constraints via context-sensitive design. Along Mobile Highway, the CMP acknowledges limited right-of-way east of New Warrington Road and discusses alternative routing via Jackson Street and rail-with-trail concepts—logic the Bluffline West Pensacola and Jackson Lakes alignment implements directly.
